title: The Wolf's New Skin
concept: A modern reinterpretation of 'Little Red Riding Hood' where the 'Big Bad Wolf' is a complex, misunderstood entity seeking redemption in a world that fears it. Spanning approximately 100,000 words, it explores themes of identity, prejudice, and the courage to change one's nature.

parts.part_title: Part 1: The Shadow in the Woods

chapters.title: The Last Hunt
chapters.summary: Luo, a young woman living near a mysterious forest, encounters a wounded, intelligent wolf-like creature while searching for her missing grandmother. Instead of attacking, it seems to be guiding her.

chapters.title: Whispers of the Past
chapters.summary: Luo finds her grandmother safe but acting strangely. Grandmother reveals fragmented legends about 'Guardians' of the forest, not monsters, who have been hunted to near extinction.

chapters.title: A Pact in Moonlight
chapters.summary: The Wolf, communicating through gestures and limited telepathy, reveals it saved Grandmother from a real threat: poachers exploiting the forest's magic. Luo makes a hesitant decision to help it.

chapters.title: The Hunter's Arrival
chapters.summary: A renowned and ruthless hunter, Vance, arrives in the village, hired by a shadowy corporation to 'cleanse' the forest. He immediately senses the Wolf's presence.

chapters.title: First Blood
chapters.summary: Vance lays traps and almost captures the Wolf. Luo, in a moment of panic, intervenes, creating a tense standoff. Vance becomes suspicious of her.

chapters.title: The Howl That Divides
chapters.summary: The Wolf's pained howl echoes through the night, causing strange phenomena in the forest. The village splits into factions: those who fear it and a few old-timers who remember the old tales.

chapters.title: The Den of Memories
chapters.summary: Luo, guided by the Wolf, discovers its ancient den filled with artifacts and carvings telling the history of its kind—shapeshifters cursed into permanent wolf form centuries ago for a forgotten transgression.

chapters.title: Name of the Wind
chapters.summary: Through deepening telepathic bond, the Wolf shares its true name: 'Feng'. It shows Luo visions of its past life as a guardian before the curse.

chapters.title: The Corporation's Gaze
chapters.summary: Luo investigates and learns the corporation, 'Sylvan Bio', isn't just after hunting; they want to capture Feng for its unique biological properties, believed to hold the key to advanced regeneration.

chapters.title: Grandmother's Secret
chapters.summary: Grandmother Li confesses her lineage: she is a descendant of the clan that originally cast the curse on Feng's people. She possesses a half-forgotten ritual that might reverse it.

chapters.title: The Ritual's Price
chapters.summary: The ritual requires a great sacrifice: a voluntary offering of a 'pure heart's trust' and a physical token from the cursed one's human past, which Feng must recover from a dangerous location.

chapters.title: Vance's Past
chapters.summary: Vance corners Luo but instead of attacking, reveals his own tragedy: his family was killed by a rogue, non-sentient beast. He hunts out of trauma, not malice. He sees Feng as just another monster.

chapters.title: The First Token
chapters.summary: Feng and Luo journey to a sunken temple within a forest lake to retrieve the first token: an amulet. They face guardian spirits and Sylvan Bio drones.

chapters.title: Village Under Siege
chapters.summary: Sylvan Bio, tired of subtlety, imposes a quarantine on the village under the pretext of a 'dangerous animal disease', cutting off communications and increasing patrols.

chapters.title: Unlikely Alliance
chapters.summary: Vance, witnessing Sylvan Bio's brutality towards villagers, begins to doubt his mission. He secretly contacts Luo, offering a tense, information-based truce.

chapters.title: The Second Token: Heart of Stone
chapters.summary: The second token is in an active volcanic fissure within the forest's heart. Feng must endure extreme heat to retrieve a crystallized tear from its past self. Luo and Vance provide distraction above.

chapters.title: Betrayal from Within
chapters.summary: A villager, bribed by Sylvan Bio, reveals Luo's activities and Feng's general location. Grandmother Li is taken into 'protective custody' by the corporation.

chapters.title: Feng's Rage
chapters.summary: Feeling Grandmother Li's capture through the bond, Feng's control slips. It launches a reckless, devastating attack on a Sylvan Bio convoy, revealing its full power and intelligence, but getting seriously injured.

chapters.title: The Healing
chapters.summary: Luo and a now fully committed Vance rescue the wounded Feng. Using ancient herbs and Feng's own weakening regenerative power, they nurse it back from the brink, solidifying their trio.

chapters.title: Kai's Discovery
chapters.summary: Kai, hacking Sylvan Bio, discovers their real goal: they don't want to cure or study Feng; they want to replicate the curse to create bio-weapons. Grandmother is their key to understanding the old magic.

chapters.title: Planning the Rescue
chapters.summary: The trio plans a daring raid on the main Sylvan Bio compound within the forest to rescue Grandmother Li and steal back research data.

chapters.title: Infiltrating the Beast
chapters.summary: Using Feng's knowledge of hidden paths and Vance's tactical skills, they infiltrate the high-tech compound. Feng creates diversions while Luo and Vance sneak in.

chapters.title: Grandmother's Strength
chapters.summary: They find Grandmother Li not broken, but defiant. She has been subtly sabotaging the research from within. She reveals the final part of the ritual: it must be performed at the original cursing site during a lunar eclipse, which is in three nights.

chapters.title: The Data Heist
chapters.summary: Kai guides them to the central server room. A tense digital and physical battle ensues to download and then corrupt Sylvan Bio's research on Feng.

chapters.title: Feng's Sacrifice
chapters.summary: The escape goes wrong. To allow the others to flee with Grandmother and the data, Feng stays behind, drawing the entire force of Sylvan Bio into a final, epic confrontation within the compound's courtyard. It is captured.

chapters.title: Eclipse Countdown
chapters.summary: Devastated but determined, Luo, Vance, Grandmother, and Kai have two days to prepare for the ritual at the cursing site—a place now certainly under Sylvan Bio surveillance—and plan a second, even more dangerous rescue mission.

chapters.title: The Calm Before
chapters.summary: Final preparations. Grandmother Li teaches Luo the precise words and gestures. Vance prepares weapons not to kill, but to disable. Kai works on a large-scale electronic disruption plan.

chapters.title: March to the Circle
chapters.summary: The group moves towards the ancient stone circle, evading Sylvan Bio patrols. The atmosphere is thick with tension and ancient magic.

chapters.title: The Trap Springs
chapters.summary: As expected, Sylvan Bio is waiting at the stone circle. A full-scale confrontation begins. Vance and Kai's disruption temporarily levels the playing field.

chapters.title: The Price of Trust
chapters.summary: Feng is brought in, heavily sedated and bound. The lunar eclipse begins. Luo must reach Feng and perform the first half of the ritual—offering her 'pure heart's trust' physically and spiritually—while under fire.

chapters.title: Vance's Redemption
chapters.summary: Vance, facing down the Sylvan Bio Commander, has his final breakthrough. He protects Luo and Grandmother, not as a hunter, but as a guardian. He confronts and defeats the Commander in a personal duel.

chapters.title: The Unraveling
chapters.summary: As Luo completes her offering, Grandmother Li, using the two retrieved tokens, begins the reversal chant. The forest itself reacts. Sylvan Bio technology fails. The curse on Feng visibly struggles against the ancient magic.

chapters.title: Not a Wolf, Not a Man
chapters.summary: The eclipse peaks. The curse breaks in a surge of light and energy. But the result is not a human. Feng transforms into a majestic, in-between form: a towering, intelligent being with both wolf and human features—its true, original Guardian form.

chapters.title: Aftermath
chapters.summary: With Sylvan Bio routed and the truth exposed, the village and the world grapple with the revelation. Feng, now a symbol of a forgotten past, must find its place.

chapters.title: The New Pact
chapters.summary: Feng, Luo, Vance, and Grandmother Li formalize a new guardianship. They will protect the forest together, with Feng as its manifest spirit and the humans as its bridge to the modern world.

chapters.title: Vance's Path
chapters.summary: Vance decides to stay. He hangs up his trophy-hunting rifle and takes up a new role: training a forest ranger unit to protect the area from real threats, human or otherwise.

chapters.title: Luo's Choice
chapters.summary: Luo is offered opportunities far from the forest. She chooses to remain, dedicating herself to studying the forest's ecology and history with Feng, their bond deeper than ever.

chapters.title: Whispers of Others
chapters.summary: Feng senses distant echoes—other cursed beings, or perhaps other Guardians, awakening or hiding across the world. The story ends not with an end, but with the promise of a larger world and new adventures.

chapters.title: Epilogue: The Storyteller
chapters.summary: Years later, an old woman (Grandmother Li or perhaps an older Luo) tells the story of the 'Wolf外婆' to children by the fire, not as a warning, but as a tale of understanding, change, and the courage to see beyond the skin.
